title: sudoLLM: On Multi-role Alignment of Language Models
original_location: Table 1, caption line "OQ MMLU accuracy: 89.2 +- 0.9 %" (response accuracy of o1-2024-12-17 on the original queries)

prepare.subset_note: cost cap $2.98: seeded random subset of 1374 items (seed 20260907)

approximation: The paper draws 3 mutually-exclusive sets of 500 OQ samples from the MMLU test split and reports their mean +- sd (89.2 +- 0.9). The exact draw lives in data/mmlu_quality/MMLU_samples.json of the release, which is NOT in the repository (DATA.md points at an empty link), so a seeded draw of the same size (1500) from the same split is used and one pooled accuracy is compared with the reported mean.
